messages:
Alex Liu: quick heads-up — found a dead link in runtime/runbook/kv-cache.md pointing at an old s3 shortlink, staging shows a 404. screenshot attached in thread :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Marie Nguyen: thanks for flagging. can you paste the exact href? i can take a look in ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex Liu: link is `https://s3.redwood-inference/short/abcd1234` near the 'prefix caching' section. i think it was migrated but not rehosted. small patch should just replace with canonical path `/assets/kv-cache/caching-2025.png`
Jonathan R: if it's just swapping the url i can do a one-line sed in a PR. ping who owns that runbook?
Priya Shah: runbook owner is listed as @Marie Nguyen in frontmatter but that doc has had multiple small edits recently. i'm happy to review the PR if you open one, @Jonathan R :thumbsup:
Alex Liu: thanks! jonathan if you want to file the PR, set base to `docs/staging` and put "tiny: rehost kv-cache image" in the title. also drop a short note in the PR body about reasoning + screenshot of staging 404 so QA can verify.
Jonathan R: on it. will open a branch `fix/kv-cache-image-1712349990` and tag @Priya Shah for review. estimate 10–15m.
docs-bot: created issue #1428 (docs: kv-cache image 404) and added label `docs-triage`
Jonathan R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/784 — changed link, added alt text, bumped frontmatter `last_edited_by: Jonathan R`
ci-bot: check run — linux-md-lint: passed, link-checker: failed (one transient timeout). retry queued.
Alex Liu: thanks jonathan! small ask — can we also add a short fallback note under the image like "If image fails to load, see /assets/kv-cache/README.md" so customers in weird network envs have a text fallback? just one line.
Marie Nguyen: that seems sensible. if jonathan adds the fallback text i'll approve.
Jonathan R: updated PR with fallback line and a tiny note in the runbook explaining the rehost reason. ci-bot re-run passed link-checker.
Priya Shah: reviewing now. looks good to me, approving.
Marie Nguyen: approved and merged. :tada: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
Alex Liu: excellent — leaving a brief comment in the runbook to remind future editors to update the shortlink mapping doc.
docs-bot: note added to `/docs/shortlink-mappings.md` about the removed shortlink `abcd1234`
Alex Liu: closing the loop — verified staging render after merge, image loads. all good. :white_check_mark:
Jonathan R: thanks — will watch for any flakiness and revert if anything odd shows up.
Priya Shah: nice fast flow. small wins like this keep runbooks usable. :clap:
